title: refactor(auth,plugin-detail)!: retire 33 zero-consumer entry exports
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuR2u8D9HqGFpUSa4p5Pj9Jc)_

Part of #25921. The umbrella stays open; this is barrel batch 3, claim 6665091931 (seat `domain:ui#6`, batch amendment from the seat after the census). Earlier batches: #30541, #30576.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/auth` 的包入口不再导出 12 个名字(Turnstile 脚本地址、两个手机号识别函数、一个无人使用的 options 类型、组织角色清单、邀请状态清单与判定函数、五个表单样式件);`@object-ui/plugin-detail` 的包入口不再导出 21 个名字(记录页合成、布局、相关卡片与时间线的内部辅助函数,一个 hook,三个类型)。模块全部保留,行为不变。
- 为什么改:这 33 个名字在仓内(包外,含测试与文档)与 hotcrm 均零引用,README 未教,也不被保留导出的签名用到;本卡逐包收窄无人使用的公开导出。
- 风险与回滚:对外是 breaking 收窄,只影响直接从包入口 import 这些名字的外部宿主;控制台与所有 `@object-ui/*` 包不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`(十处导出改写)、`ui/packages/auth/src/index.ts`(六处)、两份 `.changeset/25921-*-zero-consumer-exports.md`(迁移说明)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -l -w -e looksLikePhoneIdentifier -e AuthDivider -e editRelatedArrangement -e useDefaultRecordPage -- ':!ui/packages/auth' ':!ui/packages/plugin-detail' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 应只命中本 PR 的两份 changeset。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/auth/src/index.ts`: the entry stops exporting `TURNSTILE_SCRIPT_URL`, `normalizePhoneIdentifier`, `looksLikePhoneIdentifier`, the type `AuthenticatedAdapterOptions`, `ORG_ROLES`, `AUTH_INVITATION_STATUSES`, `isAuthInvitationStatus`, `AUTH_FIELD_LABEL_CLASS`, `AUTH_INPUT_CLASS`, `AuthCheckIcon`, `AuthDivider`, `AuthMailIcon`. The invitation block keeps `export type { AuthInvitationStatus }` and its comment now says the list and guard stay in `invitation-status.ts`. The `phone-identifier` export line goes entirely.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`: the entry stops exporting `queueClaimAdmitted`, `extractLookupId`, `TEXTUAL_REF_FALLBACK_TYPES`, `inferDetailColumns`, `applyAutoSpan`, `applyDetailAutoLayout`, the type `DetailTabsProps` (`DetailTabs` itself was never on the entry), `buildDefaultDiscussion`, `buildDefaultTimeline`, `deriveStages`, `RECORD_PAGE_WIDE_MIN_WIDTH`, `recordPageColumnOfTab`, the type `RecordPageColumn`, `useDefaultRecordPage`, `relatedCountTargetOf`, `filterTimelineStream`, `RELATED_CARD_NEW_BADGE_MS`, `editRelatedArrangement`, `relatedCardId`, `relatedDefaultOrderHash`, the type `RelatedArrangementEdit`.
- Two new changesets, `.changeset/25921-auth-zero-consumer-exports.md` and `.changeset/25921-plugin-detail-zero-consumer-exports.md`: patch level, `!` title, BREAKING paragraph, FROM/TO lines for every retired name, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` naming every operand.
- No module file is deleted and no test moves: every retired name keeps 1 to 7 in-package readers, and no test imports one from the entry (the only entry-importing test, `ownerChangeReport-10193.test.tsx`, reads two kept names).

## Why

Card #25921 narrows `ui/packages` barrels to names someone imports. The checker export list after this PR is exactly the census list minus these 33 (auth 90 to 78, plugin-detail 162 to 141), nothing added.

## Tests

Census on `origin/main` 4831d500 with the method of batches 1 and 2: entry export names from the TypeScript checker; per name `git grep -o -w -F` outside the package, minus `**/CHANGELOG.md`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `.changeset/**` (test files count); the package README, other `*.md` and `demo/`; keep rule 3 (reached from a kept export's declared signature, checker walk); hotcrm `6961ab1`. Full table: project file `issue-25921-seat6/census-b3.md`.

| Package | Entry names | Zero outside hits | Kept (README or rule 3) | Retired |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `@object-ui/auth` | 90 | 35 | 23 (Props, Labels, auth types, `ORG_ROLE_OWNER`) | 12 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-detail` | 162 | 56 | 35 (README-taught, or Props and types reached by kept exports) | 21 |

Controls (outside hits): `createAuthenticatedFetch` 311, `orgRoleGrade` 12, `ORG_ROLE_LABELS` 4, `AUTH_LINK_CLASS` 3, `TurnstileWidget` 1; `isWideFieldType` 10, `InlineFieldInput` 7, `recordSitsInQueue` 1, `DefaultRecordPageContext` 1, `prefetchRelatedCounts` 1; hotcrm `ListView` 7. Packages swept and not chosen: `plugin-grid` and `plugin-form` (their README "Exports" block lists every entry name, so 0 after the README rule), `data-objectstack` (zero-hit values are mostly error classes the adapter throws), `components` / `core` / `react` / `fields` (larger, left for later batches).

Readings at 79ddb13a:

- Build: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` VERDICT command-exit 0; then `turbo run build --force` for the two packages (52 of 52) and `type-check` for both (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth test`: Test Files 45 passed (45), Tests 398 passed (398). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail test`: Test Files 373 passed, 1 skipped (374), Tests 3338 passed, 18 skipped (3356). One lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `vitest run scripts/` (ui): Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped (172); Tests 4970 passed, 2 skipped (4972); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `check:readme-exports`: `0 fabricated, 0 stale omission(s)`; exit 1 only on the known unbuilt `packages/cli` prerequisite (`serve`, `init`). `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, 0 anchored files.
- Reverse check on the rebuilt `.d.ts`: a temporary `app-shell` probe importing the 33 retired names plus 10 kept controls, `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in `ui/packages/app-shell`: exactly 33 errors (`TS2305` / `TS2724 … has no exported member`), one per retired name, all in the probe; 0 errors elsewhere in `app-shell`; the controls resolved. Probe deleted; `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Dogfood battery (closure above plus `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock): Test Files 420 passed, 3 skipped (423); Tests 3496 passed, 36 skipped (3532); VERDICT command-exit 0 (20m47s, shared box).
- No ablation: export lines removed, no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Branch name is the platform-assigned `claude/project-thread-rr6ip0`, not `claude/issue-25921-*`.
- The auth entry comment says the form primitives are "exposed so consumers can build custom forms"; five of the eleven had no consumer and leave, the six with consumers stay. A host that wants the full kit can ask for them back.
- A contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue (narrowing batch); the seat runs it.
- Left for later batches: `components` (about 65 zero-hit shadcn sub-parts), `core` (about 47), `react` (about 25), `fields` (9), `layout` / `plugin-editor` / `permissions` (1 each).

## Verification

Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 29 families) all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 29 derived, 29 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero, every line with an exit code). CI check-runs on this PR are the record for every family CI runs.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the fleet's required Chinese summary)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
